debrief db-021

2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d r-a-d-i-o f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y l-o-g-s a-n-d m-a-l-w-a-r-e c-o-d-e o-n t-h-e l-o-c-a-l n-e-t-w-o-r-k n-o-d-e-s.

5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d t-h-e d-i-g-i-t-a-l t-r-a-i-l-s b-y r-e-s-e-t-t-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-a-c-o-n h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e, d-e-l-e-t-i-n-g t-h-e o-b-s-e-r-v-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s.
